title: From Guidelines to Practice: A New Paradigm for Arabic Language Model Evaluation
reasoning: The paper proposes an evaluation framework and dataset (ADMD) that specifically includes 'Islamic & Religious Studies' as a major domain, assessing models on religious topics such as Quranic Exegesis, Hadith, Fiqh, and Creed. Furthermore, it defines a 'Philosophical and Ethical Basis' as one of the essential theoretical standards for aligning models with Arabic cultural contexts.
